data.body: CHECKPOINT:sprint-paused:HARNESS_BUG — Batch-1 (Layer-0: 315a/55c7/5e96/b5fd) dispatched with isolation:worktree; all 4 agents completed correctly BUT the Claude Code harness reaped all 4 isolated worktrees before harvest (907d failure mode). GREEN work (315a SKILL.md+.gitignore, 5e96 4 fixtures) survived only because the general-purpose agents copied into the session worktree — saved to /tmp/waxen-batch1-staged-1780374230.patch and git stash. The 2 RED tests (55c7, b5fd) were lost with their reaped worktrees (both validly written + confirmed RED before loss; cheap to re-create). All 4 tasks reverted to open. Sprint PAUSED pending fix of the worktree-reaping bug (filed separately, ADVANCED fix-bug). RESUME: /dso:sprint waxen-sigma after the bug is resolved.
